title: Add Timeline
content: Create timeline component for history, process steps, or events. Vertical layout: centered line with alternating left/right content cards (md:flex-row-reverse for alternating). Connector: absolute positioned line (w-0.5 bg-gray-200) with circular nodes at each event. Node styling: colored circles (bg-blue-600) with icons inside for different event types. Content cards: date/time, title, description, optional image or icon. Horizontal variant: flex-row with scroll, timeline below items. Add animations: line drawing effect, cards fading in on scroll. Active/current state with different node color and pulsing effect. Collapsible details for long content. Mobile: single column with line on left side.

variants.simple: Create a timeline for history, events, or process steps.
variants.detailed: Create timeline component for history, process steps, or events. Vertical layout: centered line with alternating left/right content cards (md:flex-row-reverse for alternating). Connector: absolute positioned line (w-0.5 bg-gray-200) with circular nodes at each event. Node styling: colored circles (bg-blue-600) with icons inside for different event types. Content cards: date/time, title, description, optional image or icon. Horizontal variant: flex-row with scroll, timeline below items. Add animations: line drawing effect, cards fading in on scroll. Active/current state with different node color and pulsing effect. Collapsible details for long content. Mobile: single column with line on left side.
variants.advanced: Create timeline component for history, process steps, or events with animations. Vertical timeline structure: relative with pseudo-element center line (::before absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-0.5 h-full bg-gray-200 for alternating, or left-4 for left-aligned). Items container: space-y-8 or space-y-12. Individual item: relative flex for alternating layout. Alternating effect: odd items flex-row, even items flex-row-reverse, both have gap-8 items-center. Node (connector dot): absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 (or left-4 for left-aligned), w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-blue-600 border-4 border-white shadow. Icon in node: larger node (w-10 h-10) with centered icon for different event types. Content card: w-[calc(50%-2rem)] (for alternating), bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6, or simple without card styling. Card content: date (text-sm text-gray-500), title (font-semibold mt-1), description (text-gray-600 mt-2), optional image or action links. Line connecting to card: optional small horizontal line extending from node to card. Current/active state: node with ring-4 ring-blue-200 or animate-pulse, different color (bg-green-600), "Current" badge. Completed vs upcoming: completed nodes filled color, upcoming nodes bg-gray-300 or outline only. Horizontal variant: flex overflow-x-auto, items in row, timeline line below as border-t, nodes positioned with ::before absolute bottom. Scroll animations: cards fade-in and slide from side when scrolled into view, line can animate drawing effect with stroke-dasharray. Collapsible details: expandable "Read more" for long descriptions. Responsive: mobile always left-aligned single column, desktop alternating or left-aligned based on prop. ACCESSIBILITY: ordered list semantics (ol/li) for sequential events, time element for dates, sufficient color contrast for nodes and states.
